sources.finding: Hash-verified official final gamebook supplies the 30-23 final, lineups, inactive/DNP lists, specialists, participation and recorded injury/return clocks; SHA-256 f399b50bc930d3e6e8f0c52067068945f805b687899b0ff42e2976b130e96123.

Los Angeles identifies James, Tomlinson, Awosika, Kolar and Thompson as injury-driven inactives, Harkey as the other inactive and Uiagalelei as emergency third quarterback; it confirms McConkey and Jackson active.
Los Angeles final injury report supplies the Week 4 statuses used to distinguish injury absences from active players and non-injury scratches.
Official depth chart binds Tomlinson to Eboigbe, James to Jefferson/Mickens, Jackson to Hart, Alt to Burke, McConkey to Harris, Thompson to Valdes-Scantling and the active offensive-line reserve set.
Seattle confirms Okada and Surratt as injury-driven inactives, explicitly names Rodney Thomas II to start for Okada, identifies Price on injured reserve, and lists the remaining inactive identities.

Official depth chart binds Williams to Mills and the active defensive-line and running-back depth used with Seattle’s explicit starter reporting.
